demo.banner: Demo mode. All candidates are fictional.

landing.lead: HRmit is an applicant tracking system that runs on your own computer. Candidates, CVs and notes live in a local database. An AI assistant summarizes CVs and proposes interview questions, but every decision stays with you.

local.title: Local by default
local.text: One command, a panel on localhost, a folder you can back up. Cloud AI is opt-in, bring your own key, and only ever sees anonymized text.

assist.title: AI assists, never judges
assist.text: Summaries, competencies and structured interview questions. No scores, no rankings, no verdicts. The hire is always a human click.

fair.title: Built for fairer hiring
fair.text: Blind screening hides names and contact details. Every candidate for a job gets the same questions and the same criteria.
